vc_checking.summary: All three target manual VCs are semantically provable under the current annotation and seed case_lib. The entail witness opens and splits the circular DLL at the selected middle node. Both return witnesses reuse the same middle decomposition and rebuild the original DLL segment; the equal-to-sentinel branch forces an empty suffix and return value 0, while the non-sentinel branch forces a nonempty suffix headed by node_next. The current return preconditions retain head <> 0, so no annotation/spec blocker remains.

analysis_groups.shared_proof_pattern: Normalize xizi_dll_links, split or rebuild a full circular segment at the selected node, and discharge the two return branches by analyzing whether the successor equals the sentinel.
analysis_groups.shared_space_plan: Use one inductive split helper and its rebuild counterpart over nodes_before; retain the sentinel-link frame throughout.
analysis_groups.shared_pure_plan: Reuse head <> 0 and identity hypotheses; derive nodes_after = nil in the sentinel branch and nodes_after = node_next :: rest in the non-sentinel branch.
analysis_groups.grouping_reason: All witnesses belong to one function, share the same middle-node segment decomposition and helper family, and fit below the controller limit of 12 witnesses per group.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: Select the natural disjunct for each generated OR. For entail_wit_1, open xizi_dll and split its full segment at node by induction on nodes_before. For both return witnesses, rebuild that segment with the shared reverse helper. In return_wit_1, node_next = head forces nodes_after = nil; in return_wit_2, node_next <> head and xizi_dllseg_unfold force nodes_after to begin with node_next. Use the second expanded return-post disjunct to reuse first/last directly.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: The three witnesses are a single middle-node decomposition lifecycle: one creates the split shape and two consume/reassemble it. They share the same helper family and proof context, have no dependency on another group, and the group size 3 is within the limit 12.
